title: OKR Lattice: Commitment Contracts and Quarterly Release Staircase
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Summary:
Create an operational framework (the 'OKR Lattice') that turns high-level company objectives into explicit cross-team Commitment Contracts and a Quarterly Release Staircase. The goal is to reduce misalignment between OKR owners and delivery teams by providing a lightweight contract template, a staged release schedule, and automation to sync commitments into Linear and the product roadmap dashboard.

Background & problem:
- Leadership sets company-level OKRs each quarter, but downstream initiatives often have fuzzy ownership and delivery boundaries.
- Teams over-index on local deliverables, causing late discovery of blocking dependencies and unplanned scope.
- Current handoffs rely on slides and ad-hoc Slack threads; there is limited traceability between an OKR, its initiative contracts, and the release lanes.

Proposal (high level):
1) Define a Commitment Contract template (owner, success metrics, non-goals, dependencies, rollout staircase by cadence) and store canonical copies in Confluence and Drive.
2) Create a 'Release Staircase' cadence pattern: break quarterly initiatives into 3 release lanes (Pilot, Ramp, GA) with SLOs and gating criteria.
3) Add a Linear integration: new template issues created from a contract auto-link to parent OKR and tag lanes (pilot/ramp/ga).
4) Build a roadmap view (Console dashboard mock) that visualizes contracts, lanes, and dependency risk heatmap.
5) Run a pilot with three cross-functional initiatives (Infra batching, Console rollout, Dedicated capacity autoscaling) to validate the flow.

Deliverables:
- Commitment Contract template (Confluence + Drive link).
- Linear issue templates and automation rules.
- Roadmap dashboard mock + docs for usage.
- Pilot runbook and learning retro.

Out-of-scope:
- Implementing full gating enforcement in CI/CD (we will start with manual gates + automation for linking).

Acceptance Criteria:
- Contract template published and approved by PM+Eng+Design (signoffs captured).
- Linear automation created that can instantiate a contract issue and auto-link to a parent OKR.
- Roadmap view mock validated with at least 2 teams and updated based on feedback.
- Pilot completes with at least one GA release lane meeting its gating criteria or documented reason it did not.

Risks:
- Teams may treat contracts as another checkbox; adoption requires leadership modeling.
- Integration complexity with existing Linear workflow and release tags.

References & artifacts:
- Draft contract (Google Drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-OKR-LATTICE-DRAFT
- Confluence spec: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PM/OKR+Lattice+Commitment+Contracts
- Roadmap dashboard mock (Figma): https://www.figma.com/file/OKR-lattice-mock
